instruction: Open the .xcf file from the Desktop, copy the image, and paste it into a new LibreOffice Writer document. Add the title 'Design Showcase' above the image, then save as 'titled_image.docx' on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);
